description: This Go source file defines an AI client library for interacting with language model APIs such as OpenAI and OpenRouter, including capabilities for chat completions, streaming responses, and configuration management.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Provides methods to perform chat completions, both standard and streaming, using configured language model APIs.

classes.name: SSEDecoder
classes.description: Decodes server-sent events (SSE) streams for real-time streaming responses from the API.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Creates a new AI Client instance with the specified configuration.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request with a prompt string.

methods.name: CompleteWithMessages
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request with a specified list of messages.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Internal method that executes the HTTP request to the API endpoint.

methods.name: StreamComplete
methods.description: Performs a streaming chat completion request, returning a channel of response chunks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes the next SSE message from the stream.
